title: feat(core,components): the html tier registers and declares code — an html page's code tag renders its text, not the field:code editor (objectui#10756)
body:
Fixes #10756
Clause-②: yes — the published `sdui.manifest.json` gains one html-tier tag (`code`, stamped `tier: 'html'`; 47 becomes 48).

Executes triage `5853741286` on objectui#10756 under ruling A on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20112 (`5852014527`): a `kind:'html'` page may author the intrinsic tags its renderer registers, and the published manifest declares that set. PR objectui#10753 (objectui#10735) landed the roster and ledgered `code` out because the only bare `code` registration was the `field:code` widget's namespace fallback; this PR is the element that ledger was waiting for. Base `origin/main` `b5b6f37531`; head `974840acbd` (one commit).

## What changed

- `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/html-elements.tsx` — `code` joins `TAGS` (registered `ui:code`, sanitised like its siblings: `className` and the `children` slot). The header no longer lists `code` as "registered elsewhere"; the exclusion comment drops it.
- `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` — `code` joins `FIELD_TYPES_SKIP_FALLBACK`: the widget keeps `field:code` and stands down from the bare key, so `ui:code` is the one bare claimant (file-surface amendment, forced by H2 below: the bare-name collision gate refuses a second claimant, and in the console graph the widget registers AFTER the passthrough and would have won the bare key back).
- `packages/core/src/registry/html-tier-intrinsics.ts` — `code` joins `HTML_TIER_INTRINSICS`; the header's "deliberately NOT here" bullet for `code` is replaced by the admission note.
- `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` and `packages/types/src/layout.ts` — `HtmlElementSchema` (zod and TS) names `code` (file-surface amendment, forced by the objectui#8499 parity pin: `HtmlElementSchema` must name exactly the tags `TAGS` registers).
- Tests — new `apps/console/src/__tests__/html-tier-code-element-10756.test.tsx`; `html-tier-manifest.test.ts` (ledger drops `code`; `declares code`; the compile case flips from refuses to accepts); core `html-tier-intrinsics.test.ts` (roster carries `code`; the squatting-widget case moves to `summary`, plus a projection case for the stand-down); `react-page-scope.test.tsx` (no `Code` wrapper); fields `registry-collision.test.ts` (`code` joins the colliding set); types `node-slot-registered-arms-8499.test.ts` (count guards 37 to 38, 47 to 48 literals); prose counts in `container-declaration-census.test.tsx` and `public-contract.test.ts`.
- Generated — `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` regenerated by `scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs` (+`ui:code`); `scripts/body-dialect-census.mjs` mirrors the tag list.
- Changesets — new `.changeset/10756-html-tier-code-element.md` (`minor` for `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/fields`); dated notes in the objectui#10533 form on `.changeset/10735-html-tier-manifest.md` (47 to 48, `code` now declared) and `.changeset/8499-node-slot-registered-arms.md` (37 to 38). `check-changeset-overwrite` reports both modifications (report-only, exit 0) and did not refuse them.
- ⛔ Not touched: `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, `kbd`, `div`, `docs/adr/**`, anything in objectstack (the lockstep port and the manifest regeneration at the pin are objectstack-ai/objectstack#20112's lane).

## H1 — reproduced on `origin/main` (`b5b6f37531`)

The new console pin, run on a detached worktree at the base commit through the real page path (`SchemaRenderer` with a `kind:'html'` page whose source is a `main` holding a `p` that holds a `code` tag with the text `inline` and `className="k"`):

- `renders the authored text inside a code element` — `AssertionError: expected null to be truthy` (no `code` element rendered; the bare key drew the field widget).
- `compiles cleanly against the live page manifest` — `expected [ 'not-a-container:code' ] to deeply equal []` (the widget declared no child slot).
- `resolves to the field widget under its namespaced key, while the bare key is the passthrough` — `expected 'field:code' to be 'ui:code'`.
- Lit control on the same base tree: `pre` and `strong` rendered their text (the control case passed on base and on head).

## H2 — the registration, measured (`ComponentRegistry` answers in the console registration graph: `@object-ui/components` plus `src/register-plugins.ts`, which pulls `@object-ui/fields` through `plugin-form`)

| key | base `b5b6f37531` | head `974840acbd` |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | `field:code` (namespace `field`, inputs `[]`, `FieldCarrier`) | `ui:code` (namespace `ui`, inputs `className`, `children`, the forwardRef passthrough) |
| `ui:code` | not registered | `ui:code` |
| `field:code` | `field:code` (unchanged) | `field:code` (unchanged) |
| `kbd` / `ui:kbd` | `ui:kbd`, inputs `label`, `className` | unchanged |
| `getPublicConfigs()` | 106 entries, 47 stamped `html`, no `code` | 107 entries, 48 stamped `html`, `code` stamped `html` |

How the `TAGS` passthroughs register: `ComponentRegistry.register(tag, Component, { namespace: 'ui', … })` — every roster tag is `ui`-namespaced and also takes the bare key (the `register` fallback branch). The bare key is last-writer-wins, and in the console graph `@object-ui/fields` registers after `@object-ui/components`, so without the stand-down `field:code` would have taken `code` back (ablation L3 below shows exactly that). `FIELD_TYPES_SKIP_FALLBACK` is the repository's settled mechanism for this shape (`textarea`, `select`, `email`, `password`, `slider` already stand down to `ui:*`). Forms resolve widgets through the `field:` namespace (`form.tsx` resolves `field:${type}`), so a field of type `code` renders the same editor; a JSON-surface `field:code` node is unchanged; only a bare JSON `{ "type": "code" }` node moves, and it now renders the element — the widget's key is `field:code`. `check:registry-bare-names` stays at 0 contested keys; nothing is added to its shrink-only ledger.

## H3 — the roster and the regenerated artefacts

Generated with the repo's own generator (`buildArtifacts` in `packages/sdui-parser/scripts/gen-manifest.ts`) over the console registration graph with the 16 plugin modules eager-imported in `dev/manifest-dump.tsx` order, once on the base tree and once on head:

| artefact | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| `sdui.manifest.json` components | 106 (59 curated + 47 html) | **107** (59 curated + 48 html): +1 (`code`), 0 removed, 0 curated entries changed |
| `code` entry | absent | `{ type: 'code', namespace: 'ui', tier: 'html', inputs: className (string), children (slot) }` |
| `div` / `kbd` present | no | no |
| `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts` | 897 lines | 902 lines (+`CodeProps` interface, +`"code": CodeProps` intrinsic) |
| `sdui-blocks.md` | 119 lines, `## html tier intrinsic elements (47)` | 120 lines, `## html tier intrinsic elements (48)`; `# SDUI public blocks (59)` unchanged |

`code` leaves `EXCLUDED_HTML_NAMED` in `apps/console/src/__tests__/html-tier-manifest.test.ts`; the ledger's liveness pin would have gone red had it stayed. The 47 count PR objectui#10753 pinned lives in prose only (its changeset and the core roster test's "three registered elsewhere" case, which stays at three because `code` is now on the JSON-surface enum too); the changeset takes a dated note.

## H4 — pins, red on the base and green on the head

Run on a detached worktree at `b5b6f37531` with the six pin files copied in: `Test Files 6 failed (6) · Tests 13 failed | 68 passed (81)`. Run on head `974840acbd` (16 files including the neighbours): `Test Files 16 passed (16) · Tests 241 passed (241)`.

| pin | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| console: `code` with text renders the text in a `code` element (real page path) | red — `expected null to be truthy` | green |
| console: live compile reports nothing for the tag | red — `not-a-container:code` | green |
| console control: `field:code` renders the widget (read-only `pre` with the value) and keeps its key | red on the registry half (`'field:code'` to be `'ui:code'`) | green |
| console manifest: `declares code` (tier html, ui, className + children) | red — `expected undefined to be defined` | green |
| console census: every HTML-named registration on a roster or in the ledger | red — `unaccounted: code` | green |
| console compile against the published manifest: accepts `code` with children | red — two error diagnostics | green |
| core roster: carries `code`, leaves `kbd` out | red | green |
| core projection: a roster tag is projected from whatever holds its bare key | red — `expected undefined to be 'html'` | green |
| react-page scope: no `Code` wrapper, `code` stamped html | red — `expected undefined to be truthy` | green |
| fields: bare `code` is not the field renderer | red — both lookups were `FieldCarrierAdapter` | green |
| types: `HtmlElementSchema` names exactly `TAGS` (38), literal count 48 | red — `expected 37 to be 38`, `expected 47 to be 48` | green |

**Per-hunk ablations** (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from `../objectstack`, `--delete` mode, on the committed head; the tool printed anchor `x1 -> x0` and the blob change for every leg, and restore proof `blob == HEAD` plus empty `git diff HEAD`; an outer hash-against-HEAD check agreed on all legs; final `git status` clean). Pin set: the six files above plus `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` (118 tests).

| leg | hunk removed | result |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | `'code'` out of `TAGS` | 13 red / 4 files — the render pin, the compile pin, the registry pin, the roster-vs-manifest pins, the react-page pin, the 8499 parity |
| L2 | `'code'` out of `HTML_TIER_INTRINSICS` | 8 red / 3 files — `declares code`, the census (`code` unaccounted), the react-page pin, the core roster pins; the render pin stayed green (the renderer does not read the roster) |
| L3 | `'code'` out of `FIELD_TYPES_SKIP_FALLBACK` | 8 red / 3 files — the render pin, the compile pin (`not-a-container:code`), `declares code` (the projection copied the widget), the fields collision pin; and `check:registry-bare-names` exit 1 naming the contested bare key `code` |
| L4 | `'code'` out of the zod enum | 3 red / 2 files — the 8499 parity and literal count, the core "exactly three registered elsewhere" case |
| L5 | `\| 'code'` out of the TS union | 0 red in vitest — the TS face is not a runtime value; L5b ran the instrument that sees it: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` exit 2, `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts … TS2322: Type '"layout.zod.ts#HtmlElementSchema"' is not assignable to type 'never'` |

Disclosed: a first ablation pass was a no-op — `ablation-replace.mjs` refused every leg before any test ran (`the replacement count moved 1 -> 1, a rise of 0`: the replacement text was a substring of the anchor) and restored each file; the pass above is the rerun in `--delete` mode.

## H5 — `kbd`, measured only

`packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/kbd.tsx` registers `ui:kbd` with inputs `label`, `className`, no child slot; it reads `schema.keys` (array) or `schema.label` and renders one `kbd` per key inside a wrapper `div`. That is a component under an HTML tag name, not an element passthrough — a different shape from `code`. Untouched; it stays in `EXCLUDED_HTML_NAMED` with its reason.

## Acceptance notes

- `kbd`: measured above (H5) — a `ui` component reading `keys` / `label`, no child slot; not the same shape; not widened here.
- ADR-0081 §2 lists no `code`; `docs/adr/**` is a governed surface and is not edited in this PR. The admission is documented in the roster's header (`html-tier-intrinsics.ts`) and the changeset. Carrier: none named.
- Observation (prose only): the `FIELD_TYPES_SKIP_FALLBACK` comment above `time` / `address` says no other package owns those bare keys, while `html-elements.tsx` registers `ui:time` and `ui:address` from `TAGS`. Behaviour is unaffected (both stand down already); noted, not touched.
- Observation: `scripts/body-dialect-census.mjs` carries a hand-copied `HTML_ELEMENT_TAGS` list with no pin against `TAGS`; updated here to include `code`, drift otherwise unguarded.
- A bare JSON node `{ "type": "code" }` used to draw the `field:code` editor through the fallback and now draws the element passthrough. No producer in this tree authors that node (the `type: 'code'` hits in `plugin-designer` / `plugin-charts` are input-kind declarations, not node types); the changeset says so.
- The objectstack side: the tracked `sdui.manifest.json` there regenerates at its next `.objectui-sha` bump under objectstack-ai/objectstack#20112; nothing in objectstack changes here.
